name: Eider Cake
source:
It's the feast day of your patron saint, and a recipe has gone missing.

A short tale of birds, books, and the cloistered life.

[From [url=https://sweetfish.itch.io/eidercake]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天是守护圣人的瞻礼日，可一份食谱却不翼而飞了。

一则关于飞鸟、书卷与修院隐修生活的短篇小品。

[摘自[url=https://sweetfish.itch.io/eidercake]itch.io[/url]]
